The result advances research into a candidate for topological superconductivity, while quantum-computing applications remain several steps away. science Science Science 2026-11-01 Two states occupy the same region Cooling allows one state to displace the other A candidate for topological superconductivity Uranium ditelluride hosts two superconducting states together Cornell University Cornell experiment finds coexisting superconducting states in quantum-computing candidate FingerLakes1.com
entries.summary: Cornell researchers found that two superconducting states can coexist in uranium ditelluride under pressure. entries.search: xAI fails to dismiss the NAACP’s turbine pollution lawsuit A federal judge has allowed the NAACP’s air-pollution lawsuit against xAI to continue, rejecting arguments about turbine permits and the plaintiffs’ right to sue. The case concerns power generation for the Colossus data center near Memphis. entries.search: Youth Olympics open in Senegal, a first for Africa The fourth Summer Youth Olympic Games opened in Senegal with a ceremony at Abdoulaye Wade Stadium in Diamniadio. It is the first Olympic sporting event held on the African continent. Young athletes representing 204 national Olympic committees and the Youth Refugee Olympic Team will compete, with the Games continuing until 13 November.
